# v0.1.0

Initial public release of WolfHolo Agent Search.

## Highlights

- Ships the `agent-search` CLI under the npm package `@thewisewolfholo/agent-search`.
- Provides live search, URL fetch, site map, Context7 docs lookup, Exa discovery, Tavily/Firecrawl web-source reinforcement, AnySearch experimental vertical search, and offline deep-research planning.
- Installs the bundled `agent-search-cli` skill for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes, and other agent tools.
- Uses `AGENT_SEARCH_*` runtime configuration and stores local config under `agent-search` paths.
- Reads legacy `SMART_SEARCH_CONFIG_DIR` only as a migration bridge when an existing old config file is present.
- Keeps provider keys masked in command output and diagnostic reports.

## Validation

- `python -m pytest -q`
- `python -m agent_search.cli smoke --mock --format json`
- `npm test`
- `npm pack --dry-run`
